top_signals.title: Citi’s Manthey Sees French Equities Volatile Beyond April Vote
top_signals.summary: France’s political risk won’t end with April’s presidential election, according to Citigroup Inc.’s Beata Manthey, who says the bigger test for markets is whether any government can command a parliamentary majority and deliver a credible path to lower debt.

top_signals.title: A shifting landscape: Where the US Army moved in 2026 and what may be on the horizon
top_signals.summary: As seasons signal the waning months of 2026, the U.S. Army’s operational map continues to evolve.
